phases: move the ring to the pole
sampling: mean + independent standard normal latent vector times empirical joint covariance modes
coordinate_system: endpoint-linear residual in local chord / gravity frame, divided by max(human chord, 0.05m)
limitations: Nine ring/pole demonstrations; not a universal human motion distribution
Single Gaussian assumption; modes or tails may be wrong
Covariance has rank at most eight; new combinations, not unseen directions
Bends emerge from curves; counts/locations are evaluated, not independently sampled
Task execution transforms and constraints alter the raw distribution
